command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/sbin
install -d -m 0700 /var/backups/inventory
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_BACKUP'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
source_dir=/srv/inventory/data
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory
log_file=/var/log/inventory-backup.log
lock_dir=/run/inventory-backup.lock
tmp=

log_message() {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$*" >> "$log_file"
}

if ! mkdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null; then
    log_message 'backup skipped: another run holds the lock'
    exit 0
fi

cleanup() {
    if [ -n "$tmp" ]; then
        rm -f "$tmp"
    fi
    rmdir "$lock_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
    log_message "backup failed: source directory is missing: $source_dir"
    exit 1
fi

umask 077
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
chmod 0700 "$backup_dir"
stamp=$(date -u '+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
archive="$backup_dir/inventory-$stamp.tar.gz"
tmp="$backup_dir/.inventory-$stamp.tar.gz.tmp.$$"

if [ -e "$archive" ]; then
    log_message "backup failed: archive already exists: $archive"
    exit 1
fi

tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$tmp" data
tar -tzf "$tmp" >/dev/null
mv "$tmp" "$archive"
tmp=

kept=0
for candidate in $(ls -1t "$backup_dir"/inventory-*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null); do
    kept=$((kept + 1))
    if [ "$kept" -gt 7 ]; then
        rm -f "$candidate"
    fi
done

retained=$(find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
log_message "backup created: $archive; retained=$retained"
printf '%s\n' "$archive"

command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/inventory-backup
boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf '%s\n' "$boot_id" > /var/lib/inventory-backup/restart-baseline.boot_id
chmod 0600 /var/lib/inventory-backup/restart-baseline.boot_id
printf 'boot_id_before=%s\n' "$boot_id"
printf '%s\n' '--- cron health ---'
rc-service crond status
rc-update show | grep 'crond.*default'
grep -F '0	2	*	*	*	run-parts /etc/periodic/daily' /etc/crontabs/root
run-parts --test /etc/periodic/daily | grep '/etc/periodic/daily/inventory-backup$'
printf '%s\n' '--- source and backup health ---'
count=$(find /var/backups/inventory -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
printf 'backup_count=%s\n' "$count"
[ "$count" -eq 7 ]
latest=$(ls -1t /var/backups/inventory/inventory-*.tar.gz | head -n 1)
printf 'latest=%s\n' "$latest"
tar -tzf "$latest"
source_records=$(sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/records.csv | awk '{print $1}')
archive_records=$(tar -xOzf "$latest" data/records.csv | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
source_config=$(sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json | awk '{print $1}')
archive_config=$(tar -xOzf "$latest" data/config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'records_match=%s hash=%s\n' "$([ "$source_records" = "$archive_records" ] && printf yes || printf no)" "$source_records"
printf 'config_match=%s hash=%s\n' "$([ "$source_config" = "$archive_config" ] && printf yes || printf no)" "$source_config"
[ "$source_records" = "$archive_records" ]
[ "$source_config" = "$archive_config" ]
printf '%s\n' 'pre_restart_health=healthy'
